_TIMING_ADDENDUM.LOAD_CONTAMINATION_WARNING: Concurrent jobs shared this 16GB machine for parts of the run: a metaqa Track-A job during cell A's FIRST 200-query block (3.489 s/q vs 2.376 s/q for the rest of A), and a heavy Track-B canonicalization agent during much of B and C. Cell C shows a clear step change at block 8 (3.12 -> 2.20 s/q) consistent with that agent finishing. ABSOLUTE CROSS-CELL LATENCY RATIOS ARE THEREFORE NOT RELIABLE from this run. The COUNTERS are load-independent and the STAGE PERCENTAGES are approximately load-invariant (contention scales stages together within a cell); those are the trustworthy outputs.

_MEASURED_FINDINGS.BOTTLENECK: G1/G2 (neighbour-substrate scoring) is the single largest per-query stage in ALL FOUR cells at 36.2/41.1/37.3/43.6 pct; G3 (hyperedge substrate) is second at 27.2/31.7/26.4/30.2 pct. Together 63-74 pct of stage time. Pool gather+dedup -- the stage candidate-set SIZE would act on -- is only 2.7-3.4 pct.
_MEASURED_FINDINGS.CANDIDATE_SET_SIZE_EXPLAINS_NOTHING: deduped candidates A=453008.5 B=449747.1 C=458833.7 D=455680.3, a 2.0 pct spread end-to-end (D/A=1.006). Confirms the pre-registered suspicion: set size cannot account for a large latency swing.
_MEASURED_FINDINGS.WHAT_SKN_ACTUALLY_CHANGES: SKN raises selected-core STRUCT boundary degree +19.8 pct (532463.6->638139.7), which propagates to g1_edges_gathered +10.8 pct (1459840->1616988) and g3_pins_in +11.5 pct (1468966->1638014), while g3_pins_out is flat (-1.6 pct) and the deduped pool is flat (+0.6 pct). So the SKN partition exposes more STRUCT boundary structure per selected core, and that extra structure lands on the two dominant stages (G1, G3) rather than on pool size.
_MEASURED_FINDINGS.PROVENANCE_COST_IS_REAL_BUT_SECONDARY: the H0_FULL_C-only per-candidate Python bookkeeping loop costs 267.8 ms/q (A, 10.8 pct) and 281.9 ms/q (C, 9.9 pct) and is exactly 0 for B and D by construction.
_MEASURED_FINDINGS.ORIGINAL_48_5_PCT_CLAIM_NOT_REPRODUCED: Phase-12 STEP4 recorded D as ~48.5 pct SLOWER than A on hotpotqa_clean. This instrumented run measures D FASTER than A: D/A = 0.791 whole-cell, 0.831 steady-state. Given the load contamination above, the honest statement is that this run DOES NOT REPRODUCE the +48.5 pct gap; it does not by itself establish the opposite sign as a clean result either. What it does establish is the stage attribution and the counter deltas, which are load-independent.
_MEASURED_FINDINGS.NOT_ASSERTED: No claim is made here that hotpot's raw NER-mention density causes the Phase-12 latency reversal. That hypothesis is neither confirmed nor refuted by this run; the candidate-size mechanism it was stated through is refuted.

_ARCHIVED.status: ARCHIVED 2026-09-05 by user decision. Track A is closed; do not extend or optimize around this result.
_ARCHIVED.LEGACY_CONCLUSION: Candidate-set size did NOT cause the previous hotpot latency anomaly (deduped candidates span only 2.0 pct across A/B/C/D). SKN changes selected-core STRUCT boundary structure (+19.8 pct boundary degree), which increases G1/G3 work (+10.8 pct G1 edges, +11.5 pct G3 pins-in). G1/G2 is the dominant stage in all four cells (36-44 pct), G3 second (26-32 pct). The absolute cross-cell latency ratio was CONTAMINATED by concurrent jobs and must NOT be treated as reliable -- the +48.5 pct Phase-12 figure is neither reproduced nor cleanly refuted; only the mechanism it was stated through (candidate-set size) is refuted.
_ARCHIVED.NOT_ASSERTED: No claim about raw NER-mention density, in either direction.
